history.summary: Compact 689 sqft 99yr 2BR at The Alps Residences (D18 Tampines) at a low $976K / $1417 PSF — entry ~6% below the $1505 district median. Affordable quantum and a deep 209-txn data series, but a modest 3.36% CAGR and OCR location with no MRT-on-doorstep keep upside ordinary.
history.rating_rationale: The sub-$1M quantum and below-median $1417 PSF (vs $1505, 209 txns) give a wide, liquid buyer pool and an efficient 2BR with the broadest tenant base. But the 3.36% URA resale CAGR is OCR-baseline-grade, there's no listed MRT proximity, and Tampines has heavy competing supply. A safe, liquid, low-quantum hold — sound but not a standout.
red_flags: 3.36% CAGR — modest, near OCR baseline with no project catalyst
No MRT listed nearby — transit access likely mediocre
Tampines/Pasir Ris has substantial competing OCR supply
catalysts: Sub-$1M entry below district median — deep, liquid buyer pool
Efficient 2BR — widest tenant demand for rental
CRL + DTL extension lifting D18 connectivity over the hold

history.summary: Genuinely cheap 2BR in a 2019 OCR (D18 Tampines) condo by MCC Land; asking $1,417 psf sits a real ~7% below recent transacted prices, and OCR is the strongest forward region in the v3.4 backtest.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,417 psf for this 689 sqft 2BR is verifiably below the project's recent reality: 2025-26 transactions averaged ~$1,523 psf (range $1,398-$1,701), with two 2BR-style 936 sqft units selling at $1,506-$1,516 psf and Dec-2025 deals at $1,506-$1,565 psf. The algo's -11.8% age-adj cheapness and -4.6% vs-cohort discount are corroborated by the web, not a quirk, and rest on healthy depth (209 appreciation txns, 25 cohort txns). D18 is OCR, the best realized forward region (~+4.0%) in the v3.4 backtest, and the asking price is near the bottom of the live PSF range ($1,417-$1,742). 2019 completion, MCC Land (ISO-certified, Universal Studios/Keppel track record). Confidence held to medium since the listing appears to be at the very floor of recent psf and the trailing CAGR (3.36%) carries no forward weight.
red_flags: Asking is at the bottom of the live PSF range, so part of the apparent discount may reflect a less desirable stack/facing or condition rather than pure bargain
Mass-market OCR with large pipeline supply in Tampines/Pasir Ris can cap rental upside
Many Alps units sacrificed balconies for internal space — verify this unit's layout/facing
catalysts: Tampines North / Cross Island Line build-out improving long-term connectivity
Tampines regional centre and Jewel/Changi employment catchment supporting OCR rental demand
